_comment: Forward DEMO executor for the two F2 survivors (scripts/fvg_demo.py; design docs/audits/2026-10-02-fvg-book-sim.md; owner approval 2026-10-02 'Đồng ý duyệt nối demo order'). DEMO ONLY: the executor refuses unless the MT5 bridge reports a demo account, and the OrderBridge EA refuses non-demo accounts itself (InpDemoOnly). OFF until the owner sets enabled=true on the machine that runs MT5.
_enabled_note: switched on by the owner 2026-10-02 (chat: "Đặt enabled: true"); DEMO only -- the demo gate in scripts/fvg_demo.py and the EA still apply.
_risk_pct_note: per trade, of the account balance; clamped to docs/architecture/risk-config.json max_risk_pct (trading_env.MAX_RISK_PCT). 1 % is the design point of the book replay.
_h7_note: F3 survivor H7 (docs/audits/2026-10-02-edge-f3.md): market entry at the next bar after the breakout close, closed before the rollover.
_tp_note: the EA requires a TP on every order; the design has none (time exit), so TP sits 5 stop-distances away and is not expected to trade.
